column1: # Test files run as several units, each one a name filter (test/unit's -n)
# over the same file, so that no unit comes near the per-file bounds (600 s,
# 2 GiB): <file> TAB <part> TAB <filter>. list.sh lists `<file>@<part>` for
# each row in place of the file; run.sh --one runs the file with that filter
# on both sides. The parts must cover every test of the file exactly once:
# the last one is the negation of the others (`!/.../`), so a test the
# others do not name still runs. The bounds themselves are not relaxed --
# each unit is held to them on its own.
# test_ast: test_all_tokens over test/ruby, every other test_all_tokens
# (whatever its path starts with: parts 1 and 2 together are exactly what
# test_ranges, and everything else (test_not_cared and the named tests).
